A '''''Darius G''-class freighter''' was operating off of the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' in [[34 ABY]]. The [[Resistance]] operatives [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]] performed a [[Widowmaker (maneuver)|''Widowmaker'']] maneuver with the latter's [[racer]], the ''[[Fireball]]'', by hiding on the freighter.<ref name="The Core Problem" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The freighter first appeared in "[[The Core Problem]],"<ref name="The Core Problem" /> the seventeenth episode<ref name="DVD">''[[Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One]]''</ref> of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series. The episode premiered on [[February 17]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
